subject: Post-discovery: Confirm tech workshop owners & access requirements
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@pivotalfinance.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@pivotalfinance.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference, hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference
Date: 2025-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: Confirm tech workshop owners & access requirements

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to learn more about Pivotal Finance’s ingestion pipelines and the latency goals for the live scoring use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: you’re prioritizing secure low-latency inference for fraud scoring (50–100 ms p95), want on-prem/private deployment for sensitive data, and need SSO + audit logging for compliance.
- Goal for next meeting: 60–75 minute technical workshop with our runtime engineers to validate architecture, SSO options, and evidence path.

Proposed windows (all PT):
  • Tue 10/28 10:00–11:15
  • Wed 10/29 14:00–15:15
  • Thu 10/30 09:00–10:15

Can you confirm which slot works best and whether we should invite your platform/SRE and procurement folks? To make this productive I’d like to loop in Marissa (security) and Hannah (platform/onboarding) from our side — Marissa will brief on SOC/Security artifacts, Hannah will cover environment access and SSO.

Action items for you if possible before the workshop:
- Share the SSO provider and any existing IdP metadata (SAML/SCIM endpoints)
- Point us to a procurement contact and any timeline constraints for onboarding

I’ll hold the three windows until I hear back and will share a one-page agenda + mutual action plan once we lock the time.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Park <alex.park@pivotalfinance.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@pivotalfinance.com>
Date: 2025-10-21T11:03:22-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Confirm tech workshop owners & access requirements

Jordan —

Appreciate the summary, that’s accurate. 2 quick answers:

1) Availability: Wed 10/29 14:00–15:15 PT works best for the team.
2) Stakeholders: I’ll bring Priya (procurement) and Samir Desai (CISO) on the slot — looping Samir in here is important to validate the evidence path.

Regarding IdP, we use Okta; I can share a metadata URL ahead of the session. Priya will coordinate procurement timelines (she’s on this thread).

One ask: can you send an abbreviated SOC/controls summary before the meeting so Samir can triage?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Park
Head of Platform Engineering, Pivotal Finance
alex.park@pivotalfinance.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@pivotalfinance.com>, Samir Desai <samir.desai@pivotalfinance.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@pivotalfinance.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.inference, hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference
Date: 2025-10-21T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Confirm tech workshop owners & access requirements

Thanks Alex — locking Wed 10/29 14:00–15:15 PT.

Samir / Priya — nice to meet you (virtually). Quick notes and attachments:
- Attached: SOC_2_summary_v1.pdf (high-level controls matrix) and mutual_action_plan.xlsx (proposed agenda and deliverables).
- Short agenda we’ll use: 1) architecture review & constraints (15m), 2) runtime demo & perf profile (20m), 3) SSO/IdP and access pattern discussion (15m), 4) security evidence & procurement path (10m).

Marissa — can you own the security evidence path and be prepared to call out where we have SOC/Security artifacts vs. what we’ll need for an on-prem/private deployment?
Hannah — can you confirm what we’ll need from Pivotal for temporary lab access (VPN/SSH users, test dataset, expected throughput)? Also please include any prework on SAML metadata handling.

Alex/Priya/Samir — if you can share Okta metadata and confirm the procurement lead (Priya — is that you?), we’ll add prework items to the MAP.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, Oct 21, 2025 at 11:03 AM Alex Park <alex.park@pivotalfinance.com> wrote:
> Jordan —
> 
> Appreciate the summary, that’s accurate. 2 quick answers:
> 
> 1) Availability: Wed 10/29 14:00–15:15 PT works best for the team.
> 2) Stakeholders: I’ll bring Priya (procurement) and Samir Desai (CISO) on the slot — looping Samir in here is important to validate the evidence path.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alex Park <alex.park@pivotalfinance.com>, Samir Desai <samir.desai@pivotalfinance.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@pivotalfinance.com>
Date: 2025-10-22T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: Confirm tech workshop owners & access requirements

Thanks — I’ll take point on the security evidence path.

Planned prep: I’ll review the SOC_2_summary_v1.pdf and produce a one-page evidence checklist mapping to what Samir will expect for an on-prem/private deployment (audit logs, KMS integration notes, retained data flows). I’ll share that doc by EOD Monday so the team has time to review before the workshop.

Priya / Alex — can you confirm the procurement timeline (target contract execution date) and the preferred PO/invoice flow? That will help us scope what items we should accelerate.

Hannah — I’ll coordinate with you on any infra requirements; Jordan, I’ll also add any missing artifacts to the mutual_action_plan.xlsx so procurement has visibility.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference
